reason: Add the regression coverage autoreview asked for (P2) on the sibling-worktree governance switch in pre_tool_use.py. I had shipped that fix untested and said so rather than implying coverage; the reviewer correctly called the absence a defect, because an ungoverned write is exactly the failure the hook exists to prevent and nothing would notice if the switch regressed. The test creates a real sibling worktree and invokes the hook with an absolute Edit target inside it, asserting the write is judged against THAT checkout rather than the session cwd's.
